d:
Shikshak banne ka sapna dekh rahe yuvaon ke lie kendriy shikshak patrata pariksha (sitet) ek mahatvapurn parav hai. sarkari vidyalyon men shikshak niyukti ki taiyari karne vale abhyarthiyon ke sath-sath niji vidyalyon men behtar avsar talash rahe yuvaon ke lie bhi is pariksha ka vishesh mahatv hai. 12 aur 13 disanbar 2026 ko sitet ke 22ven sanskaran ka aayojan kiya jana hai.
